summary: Local public registry preparation composes public Atlas seed synchronization, registry projections and exact twelve-target organization retirement, then the maintained raw Kit source lock, both skill manifests, own registry rows and affected-output recheck. The lock stage uses the existing repos.sh roster selector and relock generator with an isolated exact roster; it bounds skill/file sources to managed public roots and refuses traversal, absolute paths, symlinks, unsupported or nonregular inputs before digest generation. Raw SKILL.md/file hashing remains distinct from canonical skill-body hashing. Stale or unavailable upstream inputs block dependent mutation; check mode reports every family without writing and unchanged preparation is idempotent. Retirement refuses malformed, extra raw, inline, padded, duplicate, partial, reversed or overlapping markers before changing any retired target. Product and shared Protocol facts retain their semantics; default full generation/check still requires genuine current engine emission against committed outputs. Independent caller controls require 27 active projection regions, ten paired skill-reference regions per root, all twelve named organization regions absent and retained product regions present. Organization reporting consumes owning/native evidence without a mandatory reporting workload, while qualified product reporter utility controls remain unchanged. The first PR4652 native cohort failed four jobs in three connected families: two stale Kit lock rows, obsolete projection counts and coupled organization/product reporting prose. Those failures and the earlier source-only closure miss remain failures; the connected source repair includes downstream callers and raw lock closure. No Kit membership, foreign producer rows, materialization predicates, publication, installed adoption or live consumer activation changes. Inert tests and source review establish no full Protocol/CLR/package qualification, native acceptance or measured savings; fresh required hosted CI remains mandatory. The next consumer cohort passed compiled skill conversion/contracts and package, registry, projection and reporter checks, then failed one semantic fixture oracle expecting an obsolete organization duplicate-wave diagnostic. Its actual final aggregate was one failure and69passes, including all late legs; this did not exercise the skipped full-engine disclosure/product callers. A complete same-class source sweep found two additional connected consumers: disclosure assertions positively expected retired organization regions, and the product wave reader parsed retired organization host loops. The corrected existing reader consumes only retained work-board policy from every installed product runtime mirror. Missing, malformed or conflicting product facts still refuse; organization declarations neither poison nor substitute for product facts. Current organization-v4 selection remains separate and gains no V1 fallback or dispatch authority. Actual batch and legacy product-driver controls cover product-only receiver versus operator coexistence and org-only missing-product refusal; independent disclosure checks require all twelve retired regions absent and six shared/product facts present. Core Protocol/Batch semantics and explicitly fenced historical analyst/review/intake controls remain unchanged. The source and affected F# tests now select the existing hosted full-engine qualification; no local compilation, native test PASS or comparative cost reduction is inferred from static source review.
title: Retire organization projections with complete retained product consumer closure
